## What and why

The 2026-10-07 harvest checked what gets recorded and whether the logger decides to skip work that passed. This separates observation from rebuild authority. **Inputs:** F1 ([brief](../../HARVEST_BRIEF.md), lines 104-106 at pipsystem `84c384f78ed44bcb96bb19c6d364519df5b5db6f`) and pinned pipfun source and test text. **Outputs:** [pipfun note](../../notes/pipfun.md), lines 17-94, and [harvest record](../../HARVEST.md), lines 17 and 36, at pipsystem `2d41c34e7e9e4de9558e39c9915c9d6302d14b2c`, separate from the pipfun pin.

## Pinned evidence

**Pipfun input pin:** `0c6a78d9884ed0965a524311537eec2a5095d60b`. The 2026-11-25 registered checkout (`~/Developer/pip/pipfun`, `PROD`) was at `7d534516a8c17c33d537681610eccd4c29211762`, with no dirty paths. Citations below use the input pin.

- **Event input and memory output:** a row records time, environment name, call, lowercased event and message, plus argument, metadata, output and trace list columns in a `piplog` data.table. The empty schema gains `logmeta` on append. No task ID, release, code hash or pass/fail column is mandatory (`R/log.R:113-137,168-190`).
- **Persistence:** the default is QS2; the logger passes the whole log to stamp. The `dlw` and `pipeline` checkpoint saves add stage and time metadata (`R/log.R:352-398,434-491`; `R/log_checkpoint.R:43-69,88-118`). The checkpoint code input includes time; that affects log saves, not work selection.
- **Skip question:** filtering by event, call and time, checking whether error rows exist, and counting grouped rows do not select work (`R/log.R:251-280`; `R/log_helpers.R:228-262`). The historical search did not locate a passed-work skip caller in pipfun ([pipfun note](../../notes/pipfun.md), lines 62-76).
